Geplaatst: 3 november
A Beautiful World With Great Potential, But Some Serious Flaws

AION 2 has a lot of potential, and there are definitely things to love about this game. The graphics are beautiful, the environments are impressive, and the world feels alive. Character customization is excellent, and the flying system is easily one of the most enjoyable features. Exploring the world while flying gives the game a unique identity.

⭐What I Like

- Beautiful graphics and detailed environments.
- Excellent character customization.
- Enjoyable flying mechanics and exploration.
- Interesting PvP and faction warfare.
- A large world with plenty of activities.
- Nostalgic atmosphere for longtime AION fans.
- A lot of progression systems and content to explore.

⭐What Needs Improvement

- The progression system feels too grind-heavy.
- Some activities become repetitive after a while.
- Monetization and subscription-related restrictions are disappointing.
- Dungeon reward limitations reduce the freedom to play at your own pace.
- Combat could offer more depth and meaningful class identity.
- Some systems feel unnecessarily complicated.
- The game needs better incentives for social interaction and cooperative gameplay.

⭐Final Thoughts

AION 2 is not a bad game. In fact, it has the foundation to become a great MMORPG. The visuals, atmosphere, flying mechanics, and overall world design are impressive.

However, beautiful graphics alone cannot make a great MMORPG. The developers need to improve progression, balance monetization, reduce unnecessary restrictions, and make the gameplay more rewarding.

I really hope NCSoft listens to player feedback and continues improving the game. There is a lot of potential here, and I would love to see AION 2 become the MMORPG it deserves to be.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐Final Score: 7/10⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

A beautiful MMORPG with great potential, but it still needs significant improvements to reach its full potential.
